versions.name: Pendola Sierra Adventure Base
versions.summary: A Greater Yosemite Council backcountry adventure base in the Sierra Nevada near Sonora, California, serving as the trailhead for backpacking treks and high-adventure programs for older Scouts within the Pendola Scout Reservation.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Greater Yosemite Council camping pages, which describe Pendola Sierra Adventure Base as the backpacking base of the Pendola Scout Reservation (Camp John Mensinger). Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate (no US Census address match); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a backcountry high-adventure base; features unsurveyed.
